subtitulo: Check out, leave the bag, say the thing
introPt: A traveller closes the trip properly rather than just leaving.
cenario: The last morning at the hotel.

dialogo.pt: Good morning, I'd like to check out.

dialogo.es: Posso lasciare la valigia fino alle sei?
dialogo.pt: Can I leave the suitcase until six?

dialogo.es: Il ristorante che ci ha consigliato era ottimo.
dialogo.pt: The restaurant you recommended was excellent.

dialogo.es: Che piacere sentirlo. Torni a trovarci!
dialogo.pt: How nice to hear. Come back and see us!

perguntas.pergunta: Why ask for the itemised bill?
opcoes: Because the tourist tax and extras land there, not on the prepaid booking
perguntas.explica: It is the last moment when a question still has an easy answer.

opcoes: Being specific about what actually helped
perguntas.explica: Specific is what separates thanks from a formula.

opcoes: A return shot — torneremo, or alla prossima
perguntas.explica: Leaving it unanswered reads as a conversation dropped.

opcoes: Unusual and awkward to ask for
perguntas.explica: It turns a dead last day into a real one.
It opened with a greeting given before you needed anything.
